messages.content: Morning all! Standup at 10. Quick heads up that we've got a few new user reports in the backlog to triage.
Thanks Alex. I'll be a couple minutes late, finishing up the feeding schedule UI.
The feeding schedule API refactor PR is up for review whenever someone has a sec 🙏

Heads up — a beta tester found a crash: if you tap Log in with an empty email field the whole app crashes. I made a card for it: [[card:card_login_crash]]. Someone should grab this, it's pretty visible.
Yikes, good catch. I'm heads-down on the feeding UI but can look later if no one beats me to it.

Status update on the vaccination reminders card [[card:card_vaccination_reminders]]: the notification scheduling is wired up and working for the 'on due date' case. Still TODO: the 7-days-before reminder, and I haven't tested what happens when a vaccination record is edited after a reminder is already scheduled.
Also FYI I'm going on leave starting tomorrow for two weeks, so someone will need to take this over. I linked the relevant PR on the card. Sorry for the timing!
No worries Sarah, thanks for the detailed notes. We'll sort out the handoff.

We need to lock in a local cache DB for offline support. I see two realistic options: SQLite (battle-tested, everyone knows it, great tooling) or just rolling with PostgreSQL-on-device via an embedded build. Thoughts?
Strong vote for SQLite. Embedded Postgres on mobile is a maintenance headache and the binary size alone will hurt us. SQLite is the standard choice on-device for a reason.
Agreed on SQLite. Our data model is simple enough that we don't need Postgres features locally, and it keeps the app lightweight.
Makes sense to me. Let's go SQLite for the local cache and keep Postgres on the server side. Can someone capture this decision on the board so we don't relitigate it in three weeks?
FYI the API refactor [[card:card_api_refactor]] adds retry-with-backoff to the outbound feeding sync calls. PR #27 if anyone wants to review.

Three new user reports landed this morning — they're in the Backlog tagged 'new-issue'. We should prioritize them. The timezone notification one feels potentially widespread to me, but take a look and use your judgement.
The sync-across-devices one worries me too — data loss bugs erode trust fast. Curious what others think.
Side note — can someone take a look at the nearby vet directory card? [[card:card_vet_directory]] It's been sitting in the backlog and keeps slipping. Let's bump its priority so it doesn't get lost.
I'm blocked on the feeding schedule editor [[card:card_feeding_schedule_ui]] until the API refactor lands — going to switch to something else in the meantime.
Quick — what's the status on pet profile creation? Did that ship?

repo.readme_excerpt:
# PetTracker

A cross-platform mobile app to help pet owners stay on top of vet visits, vaccinations, and feeding schedules. Built with a shared core and native mobile shells.

## Status
Active development toward v1.0.
